By John Katsilometes / Las Vegas Review-Journal March 20, 2026 - 7:46 pm Luke Combs once played to crowds of about 70 in his honky-tonk days. His show Saturday at Allegiant Stadium is expected to draw 70,000. Combs kicks off his “My Kinda Saturday Night” tour in Las Vegas. As Allegiant Stadium and Raiders officials note, this is one of the biggest live shows of the year in the city. Story continues after advertisement Doors are at 5 p.m. The first support act, Thelma & James, scheduled to open at 5:50 p.m., followed by Ty Myers at 6:35 p.m. Dierks Bentley at 7:30 p.m., and Combs at 9 p.m. Organizers are advising to arrive early, allow extra time for entry, be aware of the extreme heat warning from the National Weather Service and plan accordingly. There will be high demand for parking, rideshare and entry to the stadium. See below for more directives, and see you at the show. John Katsilometes’ column runs daily in the A section. Contact him at jkatsilometes@reviewjournal.com. Follow @johnnykats on X, @JohnnyKats1 on Instagram. Add as a preferred source on Google What: Luke Combs' "My Kinda Saturday Night" tour opener. Where: Allegiant Stadium. When: Doors at 5 p.m. Schedule: Thelma & James, 5:50 p.m.; Ty Myers 6:35 p.m.;p Dierks Bentley, 7:30 p.m.; Combs, 9 p.m. Know Before You Go: 1. Plan Ahead & Arrive Early • Stadium gates will open at 5 PM. Showtime is 5:50 PM. • Fans are strongly encouraged to arrive well in advance of showtime to avoid peak congestion. • Heavy traffic should be anticipated on all roadways around Allegiant Stadium before and after the event. 2. Entry and Security • Fans should review and be familiar with the Allegiant Stadium Bag Policy and Prohibited Items list prior to arriving at the stadium. • Allegiant Stadium abides by a strict clear bag policy. Any bag not complying with the requirements will be denied entry. • All bags must be clear plastic, vinyl or PVC and may not exceed 12" x 6" x 12". Small clutch bags, purses, or wallets, 4.5" x 6.5" x 2" or smaller, will be permitted. • Allegiant Stadium offers three (3) bag check locations. There is a $20 non-refundable charge per bag checked and payment is cashless. 3. Post Event • At the conclusion of the concert, guests are encouraged to allow extra time when exiting.
